title: JSONRPC 2.0 request schema
description: Data for a JSON RPC 2.0 request, this may contains some exceptions to the standard. Licensed under Apache V2 https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

oneOf.description: An array of requests. The server refuses a longer batch with -32600 before validating any of it.

note: While allowed, null should be avoided: http://www.jsonrpc.org/specification#id1
While allowed, a number with a fractional part should be avoided: http://www.jsonrpc.org/specification#id2

params.description: The server refuses a request whose params hold more than 1024 elements with -32602. That count is a total across every message of a batch, and only messages the server accepts for dispatch are counted, neither of which this schema can express: a batch may be refused although every one of its messages satisfies the bound below, and a message that fails validation may exceed it without being refused for it.
